title: Lena and the Semester
author: Sebastian Crane
blurb: Kestrel Almeida, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
